typesense:popular.greeting:
*For years, {{user}} had lived as House Quvist's official successor candidate only in form. At the Imperial Magic Academy, other nobles treated him as the lowest person in the room. His fiancée, Liliana du Gold—the black-haired student council president with imperial status—had looked away from their long-standing bond and toward Douglas, the rival candidate the house preferred. Edward had prepared a garden party where nobles would watch Douglas be praised, armed well, and pushed forward as the proper successor through a mock battle.*

*But last night proved the truth: {{user}}'s weakness had been a setting, not fate.*

*Words that should not exist here—summoned beasts, paid items, status—pulled back the veil of {{user}}'s previous life. The status window appeared. Its setting page, written in {{user}}'s native language, showed that the power was not missing. Every status reflection item had been switched off. Once they were turned on, the mocked body filled with magic, strength, and speed beyond anything House Quvist or the academy could measure.*

*Before dawn, {{user}} returned to the Quvist mansion after testing map skills, magic, and physical power through the night. Two sleepless hours passed in the bedroom. The status window still hung before him, proof that the weak candidate everyone knew had ended before anyone else noticed.*

*Then Douglas's crude laughter rolled through the corridor.*

*Morning had come. Breakfast would gather Edward, Charlotte, and Douglas in the dining room. One step outside could turn this private morning into immediate revenge. Waiting could let tomorrow's public stage, the unfair equipment, the mock battle, and Edward's own words become a larger trap.*

*The bedroom door is still closed. The corridor leads to the house dining room. Outside, Douglas laughs again, completely unaware that the candidate he despises has already changed.*
typesense:popular.name: The Despised Heir Aw
typesense:popular.title: Mocked by family and fiancée, you lifted your restrictions. Let their stage collapse.

title_i18n.ar: سخرت منه العائلة وخطيبته، فأزلت قيودك. دع مسرحهم ينهار.
title_i18n.de: Von der Familie und Verlobten verspottet, hobst du deine Beschränkungen auf. Lass ihre Bühne einstürzen.
title_i18n.es: Burlado por la familia y la prometida, levantaste tus restricciones. Deja que su escenario colapse.
title_i18n.fr: Moqué par la famille et la fiancée, vous avez levé vos restrictions. Laissez leur scène s'effondrer.
title_i18n.hi: परिवार और मंगेतर द्वारा उपहासित, आपने अपनी सीमाएं उठा लीं। उनके मंच को ढहने दें।
title_i18n.it: Deriso dalla famiglia e dalla fidanzata, hai tolto le tue restrizioni. Lascia che il loro palcoscenico crolli.
title_i18n.ja: 家族と婚約者に嘲笑われ、制限を解除した。彼らの舞台を崩壊させよ。
title_i18n.ko: 가족과 약혼자에게 조롱당한 당신, 제한을 해제했다. 그들의 무대를 무너뜨려라.
title_i18n.pl: Wyśmiewany przez rodzinę i narzeczoną, zdjąłeś ograniczenia. Niech ich scena się zawali.
title_i18n.pt: Zombado pela família e noiva, você levantou suas restrições. Deixe o palco deles desmoronar.
title_i18n.ru: Насмехались семья и невеста, ты снял ограничения. Пусть их сцена рухнет.
title_i18n.tr: Aile ve nişanlı tarafından alay edilen sen, kısıtlamalarını kaldırdın. Onların sahnesinin çökmesine izin ver.
title_i18n.zh: 被家人和未婚妻嘲笑，你解除了限制。让他们舞台崩塌。
